items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: I even played with Bunk Johnson.

ctx.x: Well, I played with those people. I played with Brother Cornbread, and many others. I even played with Bunk Johnson. I played gigs with, you know, many of them old timers way, way back, where they was in the game and then fell out of it.
Tell me when, now how old were you when you played with Bunk? Was this a?
